Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.social

Class IdentitiesPageController

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.social.IdentitiesPageController
All Implemented Interfaces:
IdentitiesPageApi
@Controller public class IdentitiesPageController extends Object implements IdentitiesPageApi
Serves the account page of the linked identities and the form post that starts linking another one, as the contract apis/auth-server/web-pages/auth-server-pages-v1.yaml describes them through the generated IdentitiesPageApi. The post records the link marker (PendingIdentityLinks) and redirects to the provider's sign-in; the provider's answer then links the identity to the signed-in account (see FederatedAccountResolver). The page exists whether or not a provider is configured; without one it lists the linked identities only. The chain keeps both behind the multi-factor policy (IdentitiesPageChainCustomizer).
